label: MOTION_3, holding: in act in a respect while another presently actualizes it there
definition: HeldMotion InAct H x r: x is in act in respect r (InAct x r) and some z other than x presently actualizes x in r (Holding.ActualizesNow z x r, definition 6ab9a832-6b0f-47ac-9f08-144444bf1cb1). Ordinary meaning: the stone held aloft is being 'moved' in its position while the hand holds it; the air is being 'moved' in its light while the sun lights it. It types the proposal that being moved is having a potential actualized, the actualization coming from being caused, on its PRESENT reading. 'Potential' is read only as 'actualized by another': the sense has no potency or lackability clause, so an act held by another that its bearer could not lack also counts; lackability (56b438a0-7fcc-4dd5-916b-1d2e2162310b) enters only in the antecedents of the premises that use the sense. On the ORIGINATING reading (the act was caused by another at some time, as the iron's heat by the forge) the sense would be the retained-power sense (iii) of docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md, which does not carry the per se regress; passing from originating to present actualization is the concurrent-actualization premise, not part of this definition. Distinguished from MOTION_1 (a7904c82-eef8-58e4-ac7c-0bb93374cb43, reduction from potency to act now): under the adopted POTENCY_1 (9f874532-f37e-590b-bec9-a9affb2762ac) what is held in r is in act in r and so is not in potency to r; given the open MOTION_1 premise that whatever is moved is in potency in that respect (STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY), with one act predicate shared by both senses, no being is moved in the same respect in both senses (HoldingMotion.Control.Certificate part 5). Distinguished from MOTION_2 (physical change). The distinctness of the actualizer is built into the sense: a thing that sustains its own act (a persistence power) is not, by that alone, moved in this sense.
note: Analyst sense, attribution deferred. The existential reading of the First Way (Feser) is the known contemporary version; it is not attributed here, and Aquinas's First Way takes motion strictly (SCG I.13 [10], read for docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md), so this sense gives a sibling route, not a reading of ST I q.2 a.3. Would be sourced by a pinned passage of a contemporary author stating the holding reading. Structural properties: not transitive, not asymmetric (two cards leaning on each other hold each other, HoldingMotion.Control.Certificate part 1), not irreflexive in the underlying holding relation (self-actualization is not excluded by the type, only by the distinctness clause of this sense).
